literature.citation: Chellini and Kneifel (2024), Turbulence as a Key Driver of Ice Aggregation and Riming in Arctic Low-Level Mixed-Phase Clouds, GRL 51, e2023GL106599
literature.read_scope: Publisher abstract and plain-language summary, not a full methodological review
literature.used_for: Terrestrial mixed-phase cloud anchor: changes in aggregation, particle number and riming accompany dissipation moving from below 1e-4 to above 1e-3 m2/s3. These rates are not lunar measurements.
literature.scenario_choice: 1e-4 and 1e-3 m2/s3 bracket the published transition; 1e-5 and 1e-2 extend sensitivity one decade each way. The extension is our scenario choice, not a reported lunar or terrestrial interval.

literature.citation: Koetsche et al. (2026), Snow microphysical processes in orographic turbulence revealed by cloud radar and in situ snowfall camera observations, ACP 26, 3277-3297
literature.read_scope: Abstract and section 2.5 on the turbulence retrieval; 26 August 2026 corrigendum read in full
literature.corrigendum_effect: Corrects reflectivity-difference units, a figure caption and acknowledgements; the dissipation threshold and conclusions used here are unchanged.
literature.used_for: An Earth orographic snowfall study identifies turbulent layers using a 1e-3 m2/s3 dissipation threshold. Its observations support treating enhanced aggregation and fragmentation together; it does not establish an aerodynamic size cap for lunar flakes.

literature.citation: Kolmogorov (1941), The local structure of turbulence in incompressible viscous fluid for very large Reynolds numbers; English republication (1991), Proc. R. Soc. A 434, 9-13
literature.read_scope: English republication, local-isotropy and similarity derivation
literature.used_for: Locally isotropic small-scale similarity. Our prefactor-one velocity increment is a dimensional estimate, not a calibrated RMS statistic or a model of intermittent extremes.

cm1_source_audit.finding: cm1setup=2 and ipbl=2 call the Bryan-Rotunno diagnostic vertical Smagorinsky closure. These runs have sgsmodel=0 and do not prognose LES TKE. restart_write.F writes tkea only when idoles and iusetke are true, and writes MYNN/MYJ 3-D variables only for ipbl=4,5,6. Thus missing output_tke is not the only obstacle: switching that output on alone cannot recover a prognostic cloud TKE field in the selected configuration.
cm1_source_audit.limits: Grid-scale velocities can be recovered. Direct dissipation, a resolved inertial-range spectrum, centimetre-to-metre gust increments and snow-aggregate mechanical strength cannot be recovered from these archived outputs. The closure includes vertical mixing; sgsmodel=0 does not mean the simulation has no mixing.

redistribution: Only citations, short paraphrases and source hashes are stored here. No outside paper or dataset bytes are redistributed.
